audit.why: The mirror is the audited side and mirror-fix.js will enforce agreement; only Level 1 stays Vayne's. The 53.26% Urgot-favoured record over 1380 games supports it.
audit.corrected: phases[1..6].side and win[1..6] set to Urgot, ratings on rows 2, 4 and 6 lowered to match the inverse of the mirror's raises.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why and phases[6].why claimed the first-item and two-item stages as Vayne's while those rows now read Urgot, and whys[5]/whys[6] said the same.
audit.why: A row labelled Urgot with a 'this is your spike, force fights' explanation renders two answers to the same question.
audit.corrected: Both stage explanations rewritten to state what he still holds — Purge's 490 range early, and the Disdain-into-Fear Beyond Death execute late.

audit.why: Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, Purge is 12/9/6/3/0s at 490 range, Corrosive Charge is 800 range on 10s, and Vayne's Condemn only stuns on terrain collision.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten with the real numbers and the terrain condition on Condemn.

audit.why: Disdain remains the punishable cooldown and is now stated as 16s at rank 1.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Disdain's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His window: Disdain (E) is 16s at rank 1 and Purge punishes anything standing still. Give ground, farm at max range, wait for items.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are skill-defined, decided by whether you dodge his Disdain flip and spacing.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay his: Disdain (E) is 16s and Purge shreds you if you mis-space.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Disdain's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King closes the gap but not the lane — space outside Purge's 490 range until item two.

edits.before: At first item your true damage out-chunks his sustain and out-ranges Purge.
edits.after: At first item he still leads: Purge out-trades you until BORK is finished.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Urgot carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on and your pattern works, but Disdain into Fear Beyond Death still ends you — fight only with peel or a wall behind him.

edits.before: Two-plus items plus Final Hour let you outscale and dodge his E-into-R engage.
edits.after: Two-plus items he keeps the duel: E into R execute beats Final Hour.

edits.before: His engage flip. Condemn or dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Disdain (E) is 16s at rank 1 and Purge 12s — engage only once both are spent.

edits.before: Urgot wastes Disdain (Flip) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Corrosive Charge (Q) reaches 800 — last-hit outside it, never beside it.

edits.before: That is Urgot's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Purge is 490 range and drops to no cooldown at rank 5 — never trade inside it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Condemn only stuns on terrain — in open ground it merely pushes him.

notes: Carried the mirror's chart decision rather than the packet's mixed chart, since urgot__vayne is already audited and mirror-fix would enforce it anyway. diff 'HARD' / diffRating 8.5/10 now agrees with an Urgot-sided chart, so unlike the mirror's side no tone change is needed here. Whether Urgot's E can interrupt a Vayne mid-Tumble is not answerable from the kits — left unstated.
